Candidate requirement: Accept a valid text-based PDF through the browser.
Proposed acceptance test: T01 upload fixture; verify import record/file hash and preview, without data loss.

Candidate requirement: Accept valid BPMN 2.0 `.bpmn` and `.xml`.
Proposed acceptance test: T02 import official-namespace fixtures in either extension; graph appears.

Candidate requirement: Reject non-supported, malformed and over-limit uploads with a clear error.
Proposed acceptance test: T03 invalid MIME/signature, encrypted/oversize/empty files; meaningful reason, no partial project.

Candidate requirement: Extract text, page identities, headings and simple tables from text PDFs.
Proposed acceptance test: T04 compare indexed source snippets with known PDF fixture and expected page anchors.

Candidate requirement: Identify scanned/no-extractable-text PDFs without inventing steps.
Proposed acceptance test: T05 image-only PDF; explicit unsupported/OCR-needed status.

Candidate requirement: Convert narrative process descriptions to candidate actions, decisions, conditions and dependencies with configurable AI extraction.
Proposed acceptance test: T06 annotated PDF golden fixture and configured adapter; compare candidate with annotated reference; review required.

Candidate requirement: Extract stated inputs, outputs and actor/role attributes from PDFs, distinguishing missing from inferred values.
Proposed acceptance test: T07 exact and omitted fields; assert `not_stated` and evidence presence.

Candidate requirement: Cite PDF source page/quote for each AI-derived node or edge, or explicitly mark it unverified.
Proposed acceptance test: T08 ungrounded candidate and wrong-page references generate review issues.

Candidate requirement: Validate candidate graph before display or save as baseline.
Proposed acceptance test: T09 invalid/missing refs, duplicate IDs, cycles and ambiguous branches; assert diagnostics; cycles not automatically errors.

Candidate requirement: Parse BPMN elements with official namespace independently of XML prefix.
Proposed acceptance test: T10 same fixture with `bpmn2`, `bpmn` and default namespace mappings; equivalent graph.

Candidate requirement: Preserve event/task/gateway type distinctions and explicit flow conditions.
Proposed acceptance test: T11 compare official-namespace fixture to expected kind, IDs and edge labels.

Candidate requirement: Preserve pool/lane assignment when supplied.
Proposed acceptance test: T12 two-lane fixture; graph groups/labels correct.

Candidate requirement: Represent or warn about unsupported XML elements rather than silently dropping them.
Proposed acceptance test: T13 unsupported gateway/extension and unknown reference; visible diagnostics.

Candidate requirement: Display BPMN XML with and without BPMNDI layout information.
Proposed acceptance test: T14 import both; canvas valid and fit-to-view; user can relayout.

Candidate requirement: Preserve source-specific identifiers and a stable mapping to internal graph IDs.
Proposed acceptance test: T15 reimport same file deterministically; source ID resolves to right node.

Candidate requirement: Display readable interactive process graph with pan/zoom/fit, task/decision visual distinction and labelled branches.
Proposed acceptance test: D16 operator navigates fork/join graph and finds a named step.

Candidate requirement: Select a node and display its details, roles, source evidence, inputs and outputs.
Proposed acceptance test: T17 click known step; inspector matches underlying record.

Candidate requirement: Add a new input or output to the selected step in a user variant.
Proposed acceptance test: T18 add/rename; variant graph reflects item; baseline unchanged.

Candidate requirement: Edit existing input/output item label and description.
Proposed acceptance test: T19 edit; inspector and saved JSON reflect changes, source text remains unchanged.

Candidate requirement: Tailor out and restore individual inputs/outputs non-destructively.
Proposed acceptance test: T20 exclude, inspect baseline, restore and compare; no item permanently lost.

Candidate requirement: Save a named process variant to persistent storage.
Proposed acceptance test: T21 save, stop/restart backend, reopen, compare to saved snapshot.

Candidate requirement: Keep original imported baseline separate from user changes.
Proposed acceptance test: T22 change variant, inspect baseline bytes/hash and diff; no mutation.

Candidate requirement: Present explicit uncertainty/import warnings and a human review state for PDF-derived elements.
Proposed acceptance test: D23 review ambiguous fixture; user can identify unreviewed nodes.

Candidate requirement: Support UI selection of a process when a model has multiple processes.
Proposed acceptance test: T24 multi-process XML; no accidental merged flow.

Candidate requirement: Export canonical ProcessGraph and variant as JSON including provenance and schema version.
Proposed acceptance test: T25 export, JSON schema validate, reimport application snapshot.

Candidate requirement: Search and filter steps by label, role, issue status or source location.
Proposed acceptance test: T26 filtered results and focus selected node.

Candidate requirement: Display a comparison of baseline and variant differences.
Proposed acceptance test: D27 show additions, modifications, exclusions and reversions.

Candidate requirement: Track review decisions (verified, unverified, needs clarification) with timestamp.
Proposed acceptance test: T28 review status saved and correct after reload.

Candidate requirement: Offer undo/redo for recent tailoring edits before saving.
Proposed acceptance test: T29 apply, undo, redo and verify expected state.

Candidate requirement: Export the rendered diagram as SVG or PNG with legible labels.
Proposed acceptance test: T30 export, inspect for missing/clipped nodes and edge labels.

Candidate requirement: Use OCR on scanned PDFs through explicitly configured local/provider adapter.
Proposed acceptance test: T31 scan PDF fixture and source alignment review.

Candidate requirement: Show faithful BPMN notation in an optional read-only view.
Proposed acceptance test: D32 compare native visualisation with source BPMN DI; no claim of round-trip semantics.

Candidate requirement: Support multi-user review with authentication, roles and project sharing.
Proposed acceptance test: Security/integration test plan once deployment requirements established.

Candidate requirement: Files and process data are kept local by default; external AI use requires explicit enablement.
Proposed acceptance test: I/T: inspect network requests and settings in default mode; assert zero file-content outbound calls.

Candidate requirement: XML import is protected against XXE, DTD/entity expansion and resource abuse.
Proposed acceptance test: T: malicious `DOCTYPE`, external entity and deep XML fixtures rejected with diagnostics.

Candidate requirement: PDF/XML upload bounded to guard against excessive resource use.
Proposed acceptance test: T: test configurable defaults (e.g. 20 MB file, 100 PDF pages, 5 MB XML); inspect graceful rejection.

Candidate requirement: Corrupt/unsupported input must not crash or leave inconsistent saved state.
Proposed acceptance test: T: invalid payload fuzz subset; application still imports valid file afterwards.

Candidate requirement: Users can determine whether content is source-explicit, AI-inferred or user-edited.
Proposed acceptance test: D/I: inspect five representative elements and their origin indicator.

Candidate requirement: Baseline, variants and provenance persist reliably through restart.
Proposed acceptance test: T: crash/restart after committed save; compare versioned records and hashes.

Candidate requirement: UI is usable at desktop 1366×768 and 1920×1080; controls are accessible by keyboard and adequately contrasted.
Proposed acceptance test: D/T: keyboard navigation plus screenshot review at both sizes; no clipped edit panel.

Candidate requirement: Imported node labels and XML text cannot execute scripts in the browser.
Proposed acceptance test: T: import HTML/script labels; display as escaped text, no execution.

Candidate requirement: Application separates local processing and AI-provider configuration, with clear user-facing status.
Proposed acceptance test: I/T: no credentials in repository/browser bundle or logs; absence of provider handled clearly.

Candidate requirement: Components can be unit-tested independently through typed API/contracts.
Proposed acceptance test: I/T: test PDF reader, XML parser, graph validator and storage independently.

Candidate requirement: Routine XML import of a 2 MB, 300-node model completes within 3 s locally (excluding initial browser boot).
Proposed acceptance test: T: repeat 5 runs on defined test hardware, record median and worst; revise target from measurement.

Candidate requirement: Pan, zoom and selection remain visually responsive for 300-node graphs.
Proposed acceptance test: T: measure p95 selection feedback under 150 ms on defined hardware, record browser profile.

Candidate requirement: Process schema uses explicit versioning and documented backwards-compatible migration.
Proposed acceptance test: T/I: open previous v0.x fixture after upgrade and verify migration.

Candidate requirement: Local user can set storage location and back up/export all project artifacts.
Proposed acceptance test: D: move backup to another machine and reopen.

Candidate requirement: The deliverable has reproducible install/start commands and uses pinned dependency major versions.
Proposed acceptance test: T: clean install from README, execute tests, launch UI on a second environment.

Candidate requirement: Logs are informative without storing raw confidential PDF text or AI credentials.
Proposed acceptance test: I/T: deliberately cause import failure; inspect redacted logs.

Candidate requirement: Baseline/variant writes are atomic and protect against concurrent stale updates.
Proposed acceptance test: T: simulate stale client edits; conflict response, no overwrite.

Candidate requirement: Application can operate fully offline with a local model for PDF interpretation.
Proposed acceptance test: T: disconnected operation with configured local model; no outbound calls.

Candidate requirement: Support verified packaging as a portable local desktop launcher.
Proposed acceptance test: T: install smoke test on supported Windows configuration, document limitations.
